description: Source code for managing CUDA streams, events, and related operations within PyTorch's Dynamo framework, including stream creation, synchronization, and context management.

classes.name: SymbolicStreamState
classes.description: Tracks the current CUDA stream context, managing a stack of active streams.

classes.name: StreamContextVariable
classes.description: Represents a CUDA stream context, supporting graph break operations.

classes.name: StreamVariable
classes.description: Device-agnostic representation of a CUDA stream, with methods for proxy creation and reconstruction.

classes.name: EventVariable
classes.description: Represents a CUDA event, with methods for synchronization and proxy management.

methods.name: new_event
methods.description: Creates a new CUDA event and registers it in the graph.

methods.name: new_stream
methods.description: Creates a new CUDA stream and registers it in the graph.

methods.name: get_current_stream
methods.description: Retrieves the current CUDA stream for a device and registers it.

methods.name: fork_stream
methods.description: Custom operation to fork a CUDA stream.

methods.name: join_stream
methods.description: Custom operation to join CUDA streams.

methods.name: record_event
methods.description: Records a CUDA event on a stream.

methods.name: wait_event
methods.description: Makes a stream wait for a CUDA event.

methods.name: wait_stream
methods.description: Makes a stream wait for another stream.

methods.name: sync_dealloc
methods.description: Synchronizes deallocation of a tensor after an event.

methods.name: record_stream
methods.description: Records a stream on a tensor.
